what: the estate's own retrieval rate — the stage-two measurement from the Vidal-Gadea roadmap, run on our receipts chain: how many recorded decisions are cited by later work
method: cross-reference analysis: a receipt counts as cited when a later receipt references its path or digest
why_this_matters: the roadmap's lesson one: writing decisions down does not make them findable - measure retrieval from the first week. The chain makes the measurement automatic: every receipt is addressable, so the retrieval rate is computable by anyone, anytime, without a manual count. His 11% took a manual audit; ours is a script against public data.
honest_caveat: the estate's chain is young; the rate will drift as the chain grows. the point is not the number - it is that the measurement is automatic, public, and repeatable.
